bench-press.criteria: Flat bench, closed overhand grip, feet planted, lower toward chest then press with head/back/hips supported. Normal controlled repetition; no prolonged pause.

deadlift.criteria: Conventional stance, hands outside legs, bar starts on floor, fixed feet, long arms, stand without leaning back, controlled descent.

plank.criteria: Forearms and toes support a straight trunk; elbows under shoulders, palms down, knees straight, no sag or pike. Hold demonstration omits entry/exit.

limits: Procedural demonstration, not motion capture or biomechanical certification.
Simplified body and shorts meshes. Eight-second illustrative cycle; actual device/production unverified.
